# ghost/pocket-readlex

Pocket ReadLex (F-Droid): look up English words in the Shavian alphabet dictionary, read the Shavian spelling, IPA and word type, and transliterate short phrases. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/pocket-readlex
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/pocket-readlex open_search --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/pocket-readlex search_word --device <serial> --param word=<word>
ghost skill run ghost/pocket-readlex get_entry --device <serial> --param word=<word>
ghost skill run ghost/pocket-readlex transliterate --device <serial> --param text=<text>
```

## Actions

- `open_search`: Open Pocket ReadLex
- `search_word`: Search the Shavian dictionary for hello
- `get_entry`: Show the Shavian entry for hello with IPA
- `transliterate`: Write hello world in the Shavian alphabet
